name: Yokai

features.name: Moon slicing
features.description: Nine moons reveal 1–3 each to set the free spins count.

features.name: Extra moons
features.description: Two scatters in the bonus add six more moons.

review:
Japanese folklore on 20 lines, with sticky wilds and moon multipliers. Before free spins start, nine moons appear and a samurai slices them open to reveal 1, 2 or 3 – the total is your number of spins.

Two scatters during a bonus spin bring six more moons to slice. A Chance option boosts the trigger. Medium-high volatility, 8,000x max and 97% RTP, with free spins about once every 161 spins. Lovely presentation.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
